name: wordburn-marketing-pipeline
description: The phase scripts every video project runs: capture off an emulator, pull an export, stage for Remotion, render, storyboard, self-check, voice script. Run from inside a video folder. This file exists for its `type` field — `beats.js` is ESM and is imported both by these scripts and by webpack in ../remotion, and without it node reparses the file on every run and says so.
